annotations.title: Get sportsbook fair value vs Kalshi price (MCP Connect or Pro)

description:
Sportsbook consensus no-vig fair probability vs Kalshi top of book, per game.

    For each Kalshi market on the slate: the sportsbook consensus no-vig
    (juice-removed) fair probability of the YES side, the Kalshi yes
    bid/ask/mid with sizes, and the gap between them in cents as recorded at
    capture. Markets are game winner (``market: "h2h"``) and, from the
    Oct 10 2026 capture schema on, the spread and total rungs nearest the
    sportsbook consensus line (``market: "spreads"``/``"totals"`` with
    ``line`` and ``side``), plus Kalshi depth/tick and the fair under the
    shin, power and multiplicative de-vig methods (``book.fair``;
    ``book.fair_prob`` is the Shin value). Informational, not a
    recommendation — this is market-vs-market pricing, not an Olympus model
    projection. Prices are captured every 5 minutes; each market shows its
    own ``captured_at``.

    A market whose sportsbook side could not be priced is still listed with
    ``book.fair_prob: null``, ``gap_cents: null`` and a ``skip_reason`` —
    nothing is estimated. ``status`` is ``"stale"`` when the newest capture
    is more than 15 minutes old; read ``freshness_seconds`` before acting on
    any price.

    Requires an MCP Connect or MCP Pro bearer token. Free keys and anonymous
    callers are rejected.

    Args:
        league: League code: "NFL", "NHL", "MLB", "NBA" or "NCAAF" ("CFB"
            is accepted as an alias).
        date: Optional ET slate date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today's slate.
        team: Optional team filter (name or abbreviation).
name: get_market_fair_value
